about: What an Edge-worker skill may ask a worker to do. A skill names interfaces and their operations, never tools; the device binds each operation to the tool it has installed and the worker holds. The value beside each operation is today's binding on a Talentsia Edge device, for reference only: skills must not name it.

documents.inspect.description: Read a document that arrived: its text, whether it can be identified, its hash.

documents.register.description: Record what a document is in the device's document register.

files.workspace.description: The worker's own filing area: list, read, write, move, make folders.

host.observe.description: Read-only facts about the device and its services.

host.services.restart.description: Restart a service the device's policy permits this worker to restart.

operator.notify.description: Put something in front of a person, with a severity.

memory.learn.description: Keep and recall what this worker was taught.

work.history.read.description: What has been done: recent activity and finished task outcomes.

team.read.description: Who works here, what each takes, and what nobody here can do.

artifacts.read.description: Deliverables already filed: list, search, read in full.

artifacts.dispose.description: Say what has become of a deliverable.

work.handoff.description: Hand a piece of work to a colleague this worker may delegate to.

decisions.prepare.description: Prepare a judgement for a person, with its options.

staffing.request.description: Ask for a seat, typed by the gap it closes.

commitments.mine.description: The promises written in this worker's name: read and update.

intent.read.description: What the organisation is driving towards: objectives and their measures.

intent.propose.description: Propose a priority with its evidence; a person decides.

commitments.read.description: Every promise the organisation is tracking.

commitments.write.description: Record a promise, update one, set its date.

briefs.write.description: Write the executive's brief or a meeting brief.

attention.read.description: What has arrived for the executive and what was already judged.

attention.write.description: Record a judgement about an item that arrived.

drafts.write.description: Prepare a reply as a draft. Nothing is sent.

ledger.entity.read.description: Which books these are and how the entity is taxed.

ledger.documents.lookup.description: Whether these books already rest on a document.

ledger.statements.import.description: Bring a statement in whole and place its rows.

ledger.reconcile.description: Prove the books against a statement's closing balance.

ledger.review.flag.description: Mark something in the books for a person to look at.

code.repo.read.description: Repositories this worker is authorised on: list, files, read, search.

code.repo.write.description: Change files in an isolated working tree.

code.checks.run.description: Run a check the repository names. Its command is the device's, never the skill's.

code.change.prepare.description: Read the diff and prepare a change for review. Nothing is published.

code.preview.description: Build a preview a person can look at.

tasks.write.description: Create or update a task on a local task list.
